description: "Rollo on the Rhine" by Jacob Abbott is a children's travel fiction written in the mid-19th century. The story follows a twelve-year-old boy named Rollo and his Uncle George as they embark on a journey through Europe, specifically exploring the scenic and historical landmarks along the Rhine River.
